load_bearing_gaps: A persistent protected transition is possible in principle without a GUC/DTO bypass, but not established by the existing authorizer. Bootstrap owns protected tables/functions; ordinary application SQL has neither protected DML nor transition EXECUTE nor owner membership/schema CREATE/BYPASSRLS. Existing application GUC scope carriage is not independent deletion authority.

Governed composition must use an already independently protected effect boundary, unavailable to ordinary application SQL. Python signature verification followed by an app-callable privileged SQL function leaves a bypass: direct SQL skips Python. A future restricted function therefore needs independently verifiable protected admission, or an already isolated governed principal/connection with exclusive transition access. Neither boundary is evidenced here; do not introduce a new principal or privilege widening to assume it away. OSS never imports governed; constructed LockedDeletionAuthorization metadata is not a capability.

Owning transaction must be READ COMMITTED, lock tenant then graph/target rows, then decision/key/operator in accepted order, retain locks through completion, and atomically persist fence, exact idempotency result and invalidation intent. Authorization, constraint, conflict, body or cancellation failures must escape the owning transaction and roll back; no caught failure followed by commit. Retry requires fresh authorization and state checks. Entry/exit expiry samples do not guarantee validity at arbitrary later commit; define authorization-at-transition sampling explicitly, or stop for a stricter approved commit requirement.

Existing src/keon/cortex/providers/postgres/ccm_graph_schema.py must eventually change coherently: ccm_shard_immutable, ccm_graph_immutable and ccm_graph_check currently reject payload clearing or require original active backing/hash. Terminal backing must be checked before content hashing, retain original identity/version, and never hash empty content under an old ID. Endpoint closure must close incident edges atomically, with strictly valid half-open intervals; equal-start closure needs an explicit contract-consistent disposition.

Existing src/keon/cortex/providers/postgres/document_store.py needs authoritative exclusion for get/list/count before deserialization and SQL limits, plus durable upsert/recreation refusal. Writer duplicate admission, staged replay/leases/ACK, exact shared-copy associations and all query/recall/API consumers must coordinate with those fences. Retracting one batch cannot purge a canonical copy still associated with another live batch; missing historical markers remain unreconciled.

Durable minimal invalidation needs retained reverse adjacency, depth-three deduplicated frontier, signal identity/time and atomic intent persistence. Apply S04 only to independently resolved parents; purged children remain terminal. No production lineage qualification follows from synthetic fixtures.
